died.name: James Forrestal
died.cause: his suicide note, a quotation from the play Ajax by Sophocles
died.last_words: Frenzy hath seized thy dearest son, / Who from thy shores in glory came / The first in valor and in fame; / Thy deeds that he hath done / Seem hostile all to hostile eyes.... / Better to die, and sleep / The never waking sleep, than linger on, / And dare to live, when the soul's life is gone.
